security_properties: high-entropy local bootstrap secret is consumed atomically at most once
requested session scopes must be a subset of launcher-approved scopes
only SHA-256 digests of bearer and CSRF tokens are held in process memory
idle and absolute session expiry are enforced
every API operation is classified read-only or mutating
mutations require the session-specific CSRF token
individual and global session revocation are available
implementation.integration_state: primitive only; no HTTP/TCP listener, CLI dispatch integration, or remote access

coverage: scope narrowing and unknown scope rejection
one winner under concurrent bootstrap exchange
exact operation scope and mutation CSRF checks

limitations: No listener or browser/client handshake exists; bootstrap presentation is not yet designed or implemented.
